pr_body:
Rows now select on click, open with Return/Open and rename with double-click/F2. Todo add lives on the scope line; empty item groups disappear. Resting rows reserve space for focus/selection tools, with native menus retaining the other actions.

```text
click             → select and focus
Return / Open     → existing destination
double-click / F2 → retained rename draft
n / + Todo        → one-line add, folds unchanged
```

Principles: P3, P6, P11
Moves: D2, D5, D6

Pad rename uses the identity-preserving contract already merged in #3900. U3789e also resolves U3309's Return conflict: Return opens, while o/Assign and digit hand-off remain. Current Rail nodes are Workstreams and Agents; Terminal access retains its existing destination and bubble behavior.

Connected App probes cover selection/open/rename, exact drafts and targets, empty-group transitions, native attention, confirmations and menu access. Isolated headless browser and real-Daemon observers exercise the connected paths. All 57 connected row cases pass, as do the real-Daemon row/attention observers and the isolated rendered observers. Web/Rust lint, message proofs and merge-loss pass. The initial workspace capture exposed old activation/presentation callers; their repaired file/scoped reruns pass. CI judges the full pushed head.

Rendered evidence: [U3789d](artifacts/ux/U3789d), [add](artifacts/ux/U3789b), [rename/drag](artifacts/ux/U3789a), [empty groups](artifacts/ux/U3789c), all at 1512×950 dark. PNGs and video are left for workflow attachment; JSON readings and the [retirement map](artifacts/ux/U3789d/test-retirements.json) record retained proofs. Journey D1/D2/D3/D5/F3 acceptance stays intact. The user reports what they meet on the Mac.

Reuse:

- Read the installed dependencies and platform menu/draft facilities first. Selected installed `@ark-ui/solid` 5.39.3: [Editable](https://ark-ui.com/docs/components/editable) supplies the editor behavior and [TreeView](https://ark-ui.com/docs/components/tree-view) supplies the existing tree interaction; [releases](https://github.com/chakra-ui/ark/releases) document maintained releases. The wrapper connects existing project draft/version contracts to Ark's input.
- Retained installed `@dnd-kit/dom` 0.5.1 and the existing Sortable integration for recognized drags; its [package changelog](https://github.com/clauderic/dnd-kit/blob/main/packages/dom/CHANGELOG.md) records maintenance. Ark handles editing/tree interaction; dnd-kit handles existing pointer gestures. Neither replaces the other's capability. Existing native menus, key registry, selection and draft storage are reused; no new parser, store, clock or gesture state machine.

Closes #3816
Scenarios: U3789a, U3789b, U3789c, U3789d, U3789e
